summary.headline: The Master Plan Implementation Committee prepared recommendations for the Planning Board on kicking off the 2030 Master Plan process in 2027.
summary.summary: The Master Plan Implementation Committee reviewed its recent coordination with the Planning Board and discussed steps toward launching Southborough's next Master Plan update. Members reviewed research on peer town master plan processes, noting consultant budgets typically ranged between $40,000 and $70,000. The committee agreed the Planning Board should take the lead on forming the next Master Plan Committee, with MPIC providing advisory input.

topics.title: Master Plan 2030 process and Planning Board coordination
topics.summary: The committee debriefed its September 28 discussion with the Planning Board and reviewed research into how neighboring towns structured their master plan updates. Members emphasized that while MPIC can offer advisory guidance, the Planning Board should lead the establishment of the next Master Plan Committee to prepare the 2030 plan. The committee plans to present its research and recommendations at the Planning Board's October 19 meeting.
key_details: Peer town research conducted by member Alan showed master plan consultant costs commonly ranged between $40,000 and $70,000.
The committee recommends initiating the next Master Plan Committee in 2027 to produce the 2030 Master Plan.
Members discussed whether MPIC's formal charge needs modification, leaning toward keeping the current charge while providing advisory support to the Planning Board.
The chair will post a joint meeting agenda for the Planning Board's October 19 meeting.
topics.outcome: The committee will share its summary presentation and peer town research with the Planning Board ahead of their October 19 meeting.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The committee approved meeting minutes with a minor spelling correction.
key_details: Approved the minutes of September 10, 2026, as amended to correct the spelling of the superintendent's name.

upcoming.what: Joint meeting with the Planning Board to discuss Master Plan 2030 planning
